sentences.text: Lorazepam , sold under the brand name Ativan among others , is a benzodiazepine medication .	benzodiazepine	benzodiazepine

It is used to treat anxiety disorders , trouble sleeping , active seizures including status epilepticus , alcohol withdrawal , and chemotherapy induced nausea and vomiting , as well as for surgery to interfere with memory formation and to sedate those who are being mechanically ventilated .	trouble sleeping	insomnia	status epilepticus	status epilepticus	alcohol withdrawal	alcohol withdrawal	chemotherapy induced nausea and vomiting	chemotherapy induced nausea and vomiting	interfere with memory formation	anterograde amnesia	sedate	sedate	mechanically ventilated	mechanical ventilation
While it can be used for severe agitation , midazolam is usually preferred .	severe agitation	psychomotor agitation	midazolam	midazolam
It is also used , along with other treatments , for acute coronary syndrome due to cocaine use .	acute coronary syndrome	acute coronary syndrome	cocaine	cocaine
It can be given by mouth or as an injection into a muscle or vein .
When given by injection onset of effects is between one and thirty minutes and effects last for up to a day .
Common side effects include weakness , sleepiness , low blood pressure , and a decreased effort to breathe .	low blood pressure	hypotension
When given intravenously the person should be closely monitored .
Among those who are depressed there may be an increased risk of suicide .	depressed	major depressive disorder	suicide	suicide
With long-term use larger doses may be required for the same effect .	larger doses may be required for the same effect	Drug tolerance
Physical dependence and psychological dependence may also occur .	Physical dependence	Physical dependence	psychological dependence	psychological dependence
If stopped suddenly after long-term use , benzodiazepine withdrawal syndrome may occur .	benzodiazepine	benzodiazepine	benzodiazepine withdrawal syndrome	benzodiazepine withdrawal syndrome
Older people more often develop adverse effects .
In this age group lorazepam is associated with falls and hip fractures .
Due to these concerns , lorazepam use is generally only recommended for up to two to four weeks .
Lorazepam was initially patented in 1963 and went on sale in the United States in 1977 .
It is on the World Health Organization 's List of Essential Medicines , the most effective and safe medicines needed in a health system .	health system	health system
It is available as a generic medication .	generic medication	generic medication
The wholesale cost in the developing world of a typical dose by mouth is between US$ 0.02 and US$ 0.16 as of 2014 .	developing world	developing world
In the United States as of 2015 a typical month supply is less than US$ 25 .

In the United States in 2011 , 28 million prescriptions for lorazepam were filled making it the second most prescribed benzodiazepine after alprazolam .	benzodiazepine	benzodiazepine	alprazolam	alprazolam
